## What upstream publishes

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Paper | https://www.cs.umb.edu/~poneil/StarSchemaB.PDF, 137 KB, free; defines schema, cardinalities, the 13 queries and their selectivities. |
| Generator (chosen) | https://github.com/eyalroz/ssb-dbgen @ `ae1e254aa4d603d8ef1f44078e5abed011634b23` (2025-04-26; the maintained unification of electrum/vadimtk forks; CMake; repo 192 KB per API; no tags/releases; **no license file**) — [tool](/tools/ssb-dbgen.md). |
| Alternatives | electrum/ssb-dbgen (original UMass code, makefile.suite build, 2024 push, no license); vadimtk/ssb-dbgen (used by ClickHouse's doc; not surveyed). DuckDB has **no** SSB generator (core extension list verified) and the SSB distributions (P_BRAND1 = category‖1-40, S_CITY = nation prefix‖0-9, LO_REVENUE/LO_SUPPLYCOST cross-references) cannot be reproduced by re-shaping TPC-H tables in SQL — **Inferred**; hence a real ssb-dbgen build is required. |
| Checksums | none published; pin the commit. |

## Licence and attribution, as recorded

* Paper: © the authors, UMass Boston; cited, not redistributed (queries are re-typed from it; **Inferred** that quoting 13 short SQL statements from an academic benchmark paper with citation is acceptable use — the README credits the authors and links the PDF).
* Generator: no license file in any fork; it is a modified TPC-H dbgen and therefore under the [TPC EULA v2.2](/licenses/tpc-eula.md) clauses 4.b/8/9 — we build from a pinned clone and ship only the compiled binary inside the loader image? **No**: shipping the binary in a published image is "distribution" under clause 9 (requires the EULA copy + legend in the image). Decision: the loader image includes `EULA.txt` and the legend in `/opt/ssb-dbgen/LICENSE`, satisfying 9.a–d (no fee, notices retained). Same applies if tpch-kit binaries are ever placed in the image.
* Attribution string: "Star Schema Benchmark (SSB) as defined by Patrick O'Neil, Elizabeth O'Neil and Xuedong Chen, 'Star Schema Benchmark, Revision 3', June 5 2009, UMass Boston; data generated with ssb-dbgen (eyalroz/ssb-dbgen @ ae1e254), a modification of the TPC-H dbgen program © Transaction Processing Performance Council, used under the TPC End User License Agreement v2.2. THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC. TPC-H is a trademark of the Transaction Processing Performance Council; this dataset is not a TPC benchmark result."

## Transformation

Converted by [`datasets/ssb/convert.py`](convert.py). Star Schema Benchmark -> MySQL, generated in the loader image rather than downloaded.

What was and was not ported:

None. (The optional denormalised `lineorder_flat` of the ClickHouse doc is not created; a view definition can be offered in `extras/`.)

## Measured

5 tables, 6,235,730 rows. Per-table counts, digests, index sets,
query plans and canonical query results are pinned under `tests/` and are
checked on every build.
